title: Model-free reference arms on the same 50 Push-T tasks (CPU-only real rollouts)

compute.note: ran while the KW-LEWM-0006 GPU sweep was occupying the GPU; no contention

design.platform: stable_worldmodel 0.1.1, swm/PushT-v1 (unwrapped, no pixel rendering needed)
design.tasks: the same 50 dataset-defined (episode_idx, start_step, goal_step) pairs used by 0004 and 0005; pairing re-verified (task key + start_state + goal_state element-wise identical)
design.termination: env's own terminated flag (success) or budget exhaustion

arms.cem_prior_random: a ~ N(scaler.mean, scaler.scale) i.i.d. per step == the CEM prior after inverse_transform

criterion_gate_R0.success_source: stable_worldmodel/envs/pusht/env.py::eval_state called directly on the env (not re-implemented)

pre_registration.primary_rule: U = one-sided 95% Wilson upper bound on the pooled per-rollout model-free success rate (max over arms); a model arm clears the floor iff its Wilson lower bound > U
pre_registration.why_not_poisson_binomial: for a 1-success observation the Poisson-binomial tail p-value is monotone in the seed budget S, so it would let the compute budget decide the verdict; kept as sensitivity analysis only
pre_registration.smoke_disclosure: a 6-task/3-seed smoke run was executed first for plumbing; the H1 rule was rewritten from the tail test to the floor bound AFTER that smoke and BEFORE the full run; smoke numbers are unused

H1a_jepa.note: point estimate is BELOW both random arms; McNemar seed0 vs cem_prior 1 vs 2 p=1.0, vs uniform 1 vs 1 p=1.0

H2_analytic_noop.reading: 0005c's analytic no-op stands; block-only counterfactual reproduces exactly 16/50

H4_progress_sign.reading: the CEM-prior arm is essentially unbiased, uniform is far more negative than JEPA; JEPA sits in between -> effort confound exposed, motivating H5

H5_matched_effort_POST_HOC.method: per task keep model-free rollouts within +/-15% of that task's model agent_disp (pool = both stochastic arms, median 29-30 matches); 50/50 tasks matched

floor_mechanism.reading: the floor is driven by the AGENT navigation term (tasks whose agent starts near the expert's agent pose at goal_step), consistent with 0005c's 85.7% agent-dominated failure attribution

descriptive_progress_per_pixel.caveat: aggregate ratio, confounds task geometry with effort; the per-task effort-matched paired analysis (H5) controls both and takes precedence; the surface tension between the two is registered, not hidden

corrections_to_earlier_experiments.old_claim: JEPA's pos_progress is significantly negative => it actively moves away from the goal
corrections_to_earlier_experiments.corrected_claim: JEPA's goal progress is at the level of an equal-effort random walk (matched-effort paired delta +4.21, CI [-11.58, +20.46] contains 0): no better, no worse
corrections_to_earlier_experiments.why: 0005c had no effort-matched control; JEPA moves 1.4x more than the CEM-prior arm, so the raw negative progress conflated direction with displacement magnitude
corrections_to_earlier_experiments.impact: the weak-action-conditioning conclusion is not weakened but made purer: the model's directional contribution is zero, not negative

lines: 0005d model-free floor 3.94%, LeWM 9.1x above it, McNemar p=1.45e-4

relation_to_section_8.role: fourth independent evidence line for the weak-action-conditioning root cause, and the only one requiring neither GPU nor model access
relation_to_section_8.statement: the planner's model-based action selection provides no measurable directional or success benefit over its own prior on this platform

caveats: E1: single platform, single task set, one checkpoint per model arm, one planner budget
does NOT license any claim about JEPA-WM model capability in general, only about this checkpoint under this get_cost wrapper and this CEM budget
model-free arms are i.i.d. per step; the real planner executes 5-step action blocks, so the prior arm captures the planner's prior, not its temporal correlation
no-op is a real rollout but with the expert's initial agent velocity injected; a hard-frozen agent is not physically realisable in this env
H5 is exploratory and must never be cited as pre-registered
